right_arm: none on the rig; reported to Dream parked at the arm file's rest, grip 1 (open); its answers are dropped

speed.retime: each row and approach leg split into equal 20 Hz substeps, all joints arriving together

dream_slots.wrist_l: head (rotation 180 applied by lerobot at capture; 640x480 -> centre-crop 16:9 -> 320x176 RGB JPEG q85)

trips.joint_clamp: every target clipped 1.0 deg inside the motor limits (a notice, not a stop)
trips.jump: any arm joint target > 20.0 deg from the last -> refuse chunk, stop
trips.workspace_box: workspace_box_viscous_waterproof_01.json: tcp/wrist/wrist_pitch/elbow boxes on every substep -> override: the chunk is cut at the last substep inside, the arm holds there, the next call follows
trips.tank_guard: every substep through makermodslab.tank_guard GuardedTargets.step (keep-out -> override as above; any other rejection -> stop) and every measured pose through monitor()
trips.lag: measured vs commanded > 10.0 deg on any arm joint (20.0 on shoulder_lift) for 2 ticks
trips.torque: |torque| > 12.0 Nm for 2 ticks, or > 5.0 Nm for 5.0 s
trips.overspeed: measured speed of any arm joint > 30.0 deg/s for 2 readings (successive fresh positions over their timestamps; gripper excluded; independent of the commands and the guard), in the loop and on every return leg
trips.feedback: no fresh reply / motor fault / camera read error -> stop
trips.dream: Dream error or a malformed / non-finite chunk -> stop
trips.inputs_unchecked: first request refused locally (nothing sent) unless ~/.dreamlabs/inputs_checked holds its id
trips.start_gate: measured rest within 5.0 deg of limits and through the guard; the Dream start pose inside the limits and the box
trips.speed: any planned arm substep faster than 15.0 deg/s -> stop
trips.stop: every exit (trips, SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP, stop_button.py): the six arm joints re-anchored at their measured pose (+ standing error, no slew: no spring-back), gripper torque off at once, then the arm joints back to the measured rest leg by leg from the measured pose at the speed cap (guard-checked legs; stopped short within the lag trip = arrived), then all torque off at the rest; never released mid-air: path not clear, overspeed, no fresh reading or a leg ending beyond the lag trip -> re-anchor and HOLD until the second signal, which aborts the return or the hold and releases.

approach.from: the measured rest (lying on the tank floor)
approach.route: core.approach_waypoints: lift shoulder/fold elbow first, then straight to the start pose
